entities.summary: Kirby Kali Yates is an American professional baseball pitcher for the Los Angeles Angels of Major League Baseball (MLB). He has also played in MLB for the Tampa Bay Rays, New York Yankees, San Diego Padres, Atlanta Braves, Texas Rangers, and Los Angeles Dodgers.
